meta.title: Decisions of Federal Constitutional Court and Supreme Court binding on other courts.

versions.author: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.subject: Original Constitution 1973-08-14 Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.content:
| Title        | Decisions of Supreme Court binding on other courts.                                         |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |

Any decision of the Supreme Court shall, to the extent that it decides a question of law or is based upon or enunciates a principle of law, be binding on all other courts in Pakistan.

versions.author: Asif Ali Zardari
versions.subject: Twenty-seventh Amendment 2025-11-13 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Decisions of Federal Constitutional Court and Supreme Court binding on other courts. |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                       |
| Last Updated | 13 November 2025                                                                     |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |
| Amendment 27 | https://www.senate.gov.pk/uploads/documents/1762598611_995.pdf |

(1) Any decision of the Federal Constitutional Court shall, to the extent that it decides a question of law or is based upon or enunciates a principle of law, be binding on all other courts in Pakistan including the Supreme Court.

(2) Any decision of the Supreme Court shall, to the extent that it decides a question of law or is based upon or enunciates a principle of law, be binding on all other courts in Pakistan except the Federal Constitutional Court.
